evidence_set: Treatment sample: Project MATCH, a US multisite trial of people seeking treatment for alcohol problems (1991–1993, nine clinical research units; outpatient arm recruited by newspaper advertisement and from outpatient programmes, aftercare arm from inpatient or day-hospital programmes); 1,307 men and 419 women enrolled; analysis sample the 1,589 with all four landmark ages, 379 women and 1,210 men. All landmark ages were recalled at the baseline assessment (first problems and worst period from the SCID interview; first getting drunk regularly and first difficulty stopping drinking before intoxication from two self-administered questionnaire items).
